g.text: [由於先前已設定情緒觸發警告，對話已跳過]
I do not think I can adequately describe to you how strange a moment it was to inject the serum, mon miracle.
I do not think I can adequately describe to you how strange a moment it was to inject the serum, my friend.
【警告：提及虐童內容。點擊此處結束。不會因此損失與里昂的曖昧值。 】
I suppose so. Though I do believe that I have had years of practice in that regard and, therefore, Entrati's warnings made it to be far more impressive than it was in actuality.
Marie and I decided to take our serums in private. I asked her to allow me to go first, experience the change, and then to help guide her through her own - but she, of course, steadfastly refused.
Chat ends. Next chat will be Lyon5FaithDay2.
Scoffing at the mere notion that I would go anywhere or do anything without her firmly planted at my side, she headed off to her own chambers.
I locked my door, stripped, and sat in the middle of my floor, as far away from any objects as I could, before I drove the needle into my side.
I had seen what the Infestation had done to Roathe, twisting his flesh with whatever he must have been wearing at the time - I had no desire to fall victim of the same fate.
When the agony was over, my already suffering vision was... blurred. Overtaken in... double, somehow? As though I could see not once, but twice.
Chat ends. Next chat will be Lyon5FaithDay2.
I am quite proud of my resilience, however, that I managed to don my britches before I retched and unconsciousness took me.
When I awoke, I was not alone. Nor, however, was I on the floor of my chambers. I was sitting in my childhood bedroom upon the creaky old floors I knew so well.

And sitting beside me was a young man. Beside him stood a figure I now know as Harrow. The young man was holding a small wooden figurine in his hands. It was jointed at the limbs - the paint long worn away, save perhaps in the creases and cracks. It had belonged to my father. It was of a soldier.
It was the only toy I could claim as my own, as a child.
I had a similar figurine, growing up. It was one of my favorite toys.
So I have heard. I believe mine proved to be more benign, in the end.
Thrax is a complicated topic. I'd rather not get into it here.
那不是他的錯。在那一刻他正是我需要的那種人。
沒關係。他正在進步。雖然很慢。但總算有點進展。看似不可能的事也能改變。
The young man and his silent guardian who visited me inside my dream- inside my mind - were all at once strangers to me and yet known to me like we had grown up together as siblings.
Quite right. We could be lost here for hours, debating the moral and theological implications of Duviri.
When I ponder even the smallest notion of what I would have conjured in your stead, I am overcome with waves of horror. But we could be lost here for hours, discussing such a thing.
If he is showing signs of change, and he is a product of your emotions, perhaps that is indicative of something else. But a debate for another day, perhaps.
Forgive me for an overwrought metaphor, but it was as though we were three trees whose roots were so grown together as to become indistinguishable from one another -
who had merely been blinked into existence in such a state. I could remember my life without Rell and Harrow. And yet, there they were. In every moment - in every instance - beside me.

As an aside, I wish I could speak to Entrati about this, I am desperate to know what manner of science is at the - no pun intended - root of this, but when we finally recovered from our change, Entrati was gone.
What little I know of the Infestation and how it works, it seems to be kind of... maybe... I don't know, outside time?
Entrati's daughter is upstairs. She studied and worked beside him. She might be able to help.
There's a... guitar... it's all very hard to explain, and we've both traveled through time via Helminth...

Which was a process I believe will linger in my nightmares for a very long time. Regardless, the specifics of how it is that Rell, Harrow, and I became bonded at such a... molecular, spiritual level, I do not know.

But the crossroads went both ways. Where they were in my life, I was in theirs. I saw the Indifference. I understood what they were standing guard against. I saw glimpses of Harrow, and the man he once was.
Now if only we were allowed to speak to her. I suspect there are schemes to that effect already in play. If so, you may count on me to... assist. I can be convincing when need be.
But the press of the Indifference took over I could feel it there - hear it as they did, tapping against the walls. Rap... tap... tap...
Regardless, the specifics of how it is that Rell, Harrow, and I became bonded at such a... molecular, spiritual level, I do not know.
All the visions of my youth, all the horrors that I had seen - were they only ever the Indifference? Was I now mis-remembering? Or had I indeed been "blessed" by Lua?
我內心的信仰……徹底崩潰瓦解了。就像燒焦的紙片，化為塵埃。噢，我多麼痛恨自己的軟弱……
Oh, Lyon... you've been through so much. Doubt isn't the result of weakness - doubt is the result of pain.
Faith doesn't need to be constant - nor is it expected to be. How many tales are told of those who lose their faith, only to find it again?
里昂，你一生都奉獻給了我們的聖光會。你認為他們會因為這種事而疏遠你嗎？
里昂，我不知道世上有沒有神 ─ 我想我們誰也無法真正知道。但我知道的是，你經歷了很多。
雖然我個人是不相信世上有神，但我知道這對你的生命來說有多重要。我不想輕視這一點。
漠然是我們造成的 ─ 他不是神，里昂。別讓源拓氏的錯誤毀了你。至於你的信仰？
我很不忍心看到你這樣，被捲入所有人的鬧劇之中。你不應該承受這些。
I'm not saying you need to find your faith again. I'm saying if you want to - if you feel you need to - it's not something that's forever lost.
Surely, Lua can see what you've been put through. What you've endured in her name.
What I think is that you need to focus on is finding some kind of peace within yourself - however it is you need to find it.
If there is a god, if your Lua does exist - surely she can see what you've been through. What you've endured in her name. It must mean something to her.
I think you need to let go of any notion of whether or not there are gods, and focus on healing yourself, first.
Perhaps you are right... And my sad tale of doubt was hardly the point. But I shall consider your words. We shall discuss this in more detail tomorrow.

I saw Rell's life aboard the Zariman Ten Zero, and all that he endured after it. I saw Harrow's life as a soldier, faded as it was through the Infestation. Just as they saw my life in Gaule and all I suffered.
It may be strange to you to know that none of us ever once exchanged a word. We never found the need. There was simply between us an... understanding.
I could hear their voices - I knew all the words in their lives they had ever spoken. But they were never directed to me.
Does a smile need a speech? Does a frown? Do you need to hear a child weeping to know he is in pain or frightened? No, we merely knew what was passed between us.
Until it... until it no longer was.
They are not gone, mon miracle... only dead.
他們並沒有消失，我的朋友……不過死了。
I can no longer hear those parts of them which were undetermined. Now, I believe, I can only hear that part of them which were.
你是什麼時候……聽不到他的？
I cannot explain it any more than I already have. I know not how. Forgive me.
The moment we passed through the Helminth with Roathe and came here, to the Sanctum. I do not know... why. Or how.
But in passing through that veil of time, my friends, my brothers.. the trees whose roots wove through my soul so closely... withered and died beside me.
Now an emptiness is there. Rotting. The memory of them still corrupting my own. But I would not give it away if I had the chance...
I can recall the memory of the first time my mother struck me. I remember it two ways, clear as Sol's brightest light, and I know all versions are true.
In one... I weep alone in the darkness of my room. In another, two figures stand beside me in the shadows.
I remember twice the first time I took a blade to my skin to clear the voices from my mind. In one, the room is empty.
In another, I hear a humming from behind me. I feel the silent presence of a stoic guardian.
If I have lost my faith in my goddess of Lua and have gained their guidance in return... it may be a trade I would be willing to give.
我只是 — 我只是對你們所經歷的一切感到非常抱歉。
我只是……很高興 Rell 跟 Harrow 能和你在一起，里昂……即使只是在回憶裡。
Could you consider the possibility that... maybe this is all the work of a god or gods? To comfort you?
Could you consider the possibility that... maybe this is all the work of Lua? To comfort you?
I don't know as the two have to be mutually exclusive, but... I don't know. I don't know as we ever will.
我只是……很高興 Rell 跟 Harrow 能和你在一起，里昂……即使只是在回憶裡。
謝謝。我很想念他們。但是……我漸漸明白，在這個地方，能理解我痛苦的人比不能理解我的人要多。
Thank you. I miss their presence. But I am... no longer alone, am I, mon miracle?
Yes. Do not think I have not considered it. I am not sure if my faith will be so easily mended, but... it is a comfort to ponder, all the same.
Indeed. Do not think I have not considered whether or not Rell and Harrow were sent by the Luminaries to comfort me. But as you said, such is not for us to know.
I am so very relieved to finally have spoken of all this with you. It is a great burden, lifted from me, and I cannot express my gratitude enough.
我的奇蹟，我現在一定要走了。
朋友，我現在一定要走了。
Chat ends. Next chat will be Lyon5FaithDay2.
